description: This file defines a controller class 'Information' for managing information pages within the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for listing, viewing, creating, editing, enabling/disabling, and deleting information entries, handling form processing, and generating relevant URLs and UI components.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Controller class for managing information pages.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the list of information pages with filters and links.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list view of information pages.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and renders the list of information entries based on filters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an information page.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list page with filters and navigation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Redirects to the list view, mainly for AJAX refresh.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Loads and returns the HTML for the list of information pages based on filter criteria.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the add/edit form for an information page.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission, validation, and saving data.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Sets selected information entries as enabled.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Sets selected information entries as disabled.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected information entries after permission checks.
